sections.title: Config that drifts from reality
body: Many schema tools need a manifest listing every object and its order. The manifest and the SQL drift apart, and the tool trusts the manifest.

sections.title: Folders carry the meaning
body: In dbd, the folder structure is the model. A file at ddl/table/config/lookups.ddl becomes the entity config.lookups of type table. Views, materialized views and procedures sit in their own folders the same way.

code.text:
ddl/
  table/config/lookups.ddl          → table config.lookups
  view/config/genders.ddl           → view config.genders
  procedure/staging/import_lookups.ddl

sections.title: Nothing to keep in sync
body: There is no list to update when you add a table. dbd discovers entities from the tree and works out the dependency order from the SQL itself.
points: Add a file, get an entity
Move a file, rename the entity
Review the tree, review the schema

sections.title: Conventions are instructions
body: A predictable layout is easy for an assistant to follow: “add a view in the config schema” has exactly one right place to go.
